# Commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_commands_doc.py from the Typer registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

Complete reference for the `nvh` CLI. `nvh "question"` with no command
routes the prompt to the best available advisor; `nvh` alone opens the REPL.
A mistyped command prints a did-you-mean suggestion instead of being sent
to an advisor, and a task-shaped bare prompt asks for an explicit `nvh do`.

## Core

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh do TASK` | Hands-free mode — give NVHive a task and it completes it autonomously. |
| `nvh review [SOURCE]` | [beta] AI-powered code review with multi-model cross-verification. |
| `nvh scan [PATH]` | Scan a codebase and produce an AI-powered analysis report. |
| `nvh test-gen TARGET` | [beta] AI-powered test generation with automatic verification. |

## Query Modes

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh ask [PROMPT]` | Ask an advisor a question — the one query command. |

## Multi-Model

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh batch FILE` | Batch mode — run multiple prompts from a file and collect structured results. |
| `nvh convene PROMPT` | Convene a hive session — query multiple LLMs and synthesize consensus. |
| `nvh poll PROMPT` | Poll multiple advisors and compare their responses side by side. |
| `nvh throwdown PROMPT` | Throwdown mode — two-pass deep analysis with all advisors and agents. |

## Flags

### `nvh ask [PROMPT]`

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `-p, --advisor` | Advisor to use |
| `-m, --model` | Model to use |
| `-s, --system` | System prompt |
| `-o, --output` | Output format: text, json, markdown, raw |
| `--stream, --no-stream` | Stream output |
| `--max-tokens` | Max output tokens |
| `-t, --temperature` | Temperature |
| `--no-cache` | Bypass cache |
| `--strategy` | Routing: best, cheapest, fastest, best-for-task |
| `-c, --continue` | Continue last conversation |
| `--conversation` | Continue a specific conversation |
| `--profile` | Config profile to use |
| `-v, --verbose` | Show routing details |
| `-q, --quiet` | Suppress metadata |
| `--privacy` | Privacy mode: disable logging, caching, and conversation persistence |
| `--template` | Prompt template name to use |
| `--var` | Template variable as key=value (repeatable) |
| `-f, --file` | Include a file's contents in the prompt |
| `--json` | Shorthand for --output json |
| `--raw` | Shorthand for --output raw (no metadata, just the answer) |
| `--knowledge, -k` | Augment prompt with chunks retrieved from your local RAG index (nvh rag) |
| `--prefer-nvidia` | Bias routing toward NVIDIA providers (ollama/Nemotron, NIM, Triton) |
| `--escalate` | Try cheap model first, escalate to premium if low confidence |
| `--verify` | Cross-check response with a different model for accuracy |
| `--focus` | Focus mode: code, write, math, research (system prompt + advisor preference) |
| `--fast` | Cheapest/fastest advisor (Groq > DeepSeek > Ollama), no frills |
| `--local` | Ollama only — nothing leaves this machine, nothing is stored |
| `--clipboard` | Add the clipboard contents to the prompt |
| `--copy` | Copy the answer to the clipboard |

### `nvh status`

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--providers` | Advisor health, scores and the failover chain |
| `--deep` | Full diagnostic: config, keys, advisors, Ollama, GPU, disk, environment |
| `--smoke` | Offline smoke test of the workspace (storage, Ollama, WebUI runtime, packs) |
| `--report` | Write a redacted JSON support bundle (deep checks + smoke + snapshot) |
| `--routing` | Explain how the last query was routed |
| `--json` | JSON on stdout (glance, --providers, --deep, --smoke) |
| `--fix` | --deep: offer to restart Ollama / pull missing models |
| `--storage` | --deep: only the persistent-storage preflight |
| `--home-dir` | NVH_HOME to check (default: the active one) |
| `--min-free-gb` | Free space expected for local models and ComfyUI |
| `--imports` | --smoke/--report: also import every core module |
| `--live` | --report: include one live Wizard round-trip |
| `--strict` | --smoke/--report: warnings exit 1 too |
| `-o, --output` | --report: bundle path (default $NVH_HOME/support/) |
| `--send` | --report: copy the bundle to the clipboard |
| `--nvidia-report` | --report: also run nvidia-bug-report.sh |

### `nvh do TASK`

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `-a, --advisor` | Specific advisor to use |
| `-m, --model` | Specific model to use |
| `--max-steps` | Maximum agent iterations |
| `--auto, --confirm` | Auto-approve safe tools (default: yes) |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would be done without executing |
| `--sandbox` | Require Docker isolation for run_code/shell (refuse the unisolated fallback) |
| `--profile` | Config profile to use |

## Command groups

### `nvh advisor`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh advisor add NAME` | Add or update an advisor's API key. |
| `nvh advisor info NAME` | Show detailed advisor profile — strengths, weaknesses, and when to use. |
| `nvh advisor list` | List configured advisors and their status. |
| `nvh advisor login NAME` | Interactive login flow for an advisor. |
| `nvh advisor remove NAME` | Remove an advisor's API key (keychain + .env) and disable it in config. |
| `nvh advisor test [NAME]` | Test advisor connectivity and API key validity. |

### `nvh agent`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh agent analyze PROMPT` | Preview which expert agents would be generated for a given query. |
| `nvh agent presets` | List available hive cabinets and their expert roles. |
| `nvh agent run [TASK]` | [beta] Agentic coding — plan, execute, and verify code changes. |

### `nvh auth`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh auth create-token NAME` | Create an API token for a user (prints it once — save it immediately). |
| `nvh auth create-user USERNAME` | Create a new user account (prompts for password). |
| `nvh auth list-tokens` | List your active API tokens. |
| `nvh auth revoke-token TOKEN_ID` | Revoke an API token by its ID. |

### `nvh budget`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh budget status` | Show current spending and budget limits. |

### `nvh config`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|

| `nvh config edit` | Open config file in $EDITOR. |
| `nvh config export` | Export the current config with API keys masked. |
| `nvh config get KEY` | Get a configuration value. |

### `nvh mcp`

| Command | Description |

| `nvh mcp servers refresh` | Connect to each enabled server, list its tools, rewrite the cache. |

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|

### `nvh models`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh models list` | Show installed models (and, with --all, the fit-ranked catalog). |
| `nvh models pull [NAME]` | Download a model into the local Ollama store with live progress. |
| `nvh models rm NAME` | Remove an installed model and reclaim its disk. |

### `nvh rag`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh rag add PATHS` | Index one or more files into the local RAG store. |
| `nvh rag ask QUESTION` | Retrieve the most relevant indexed chunks for a question. |
| `nvh rag import-legacy` | One-shot import of the pre-0.42 ~/.hive/knowledge store (or, with --memories, the REPL memories). |
| `nvh rag ingest FOLDER` | Walk a folder and index every supported document in it. |
| `nvh rag list` | List collections in the local RAG store. |
| `nvh rag remove SOURCE` | Drop every chunk of one source from a collection. |

### `nvh schedule`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh schedule add PROMPT` | Add a recurring scheduled task. |
| `nvh schedule list` | List all scheduled tasks. |
| `nvh schedule remove TASK_ID` | Remove a scheduled task. |
| `nvh schedule start` | Start the scheduler daemon (runs in foreground, polls for due tasks). |

### `nvh services`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh services restart` | Graceful kill of all three services, then ``services start``. |
| `nvh services smoke-test` | End-to-end "can the Wizard actually answer?" check. |
| `nvh services start` | Boot the whole pipeline in order, with real health gates. |
| `nvh services stop` | Stop the nvHive service stack — WebUI + API (+ optional Ollama). |

### `nvh webhook`

| Command | Description |

| `nvh webhook list` | Show configured webhooks. |
| `nvh webhook test URL` | Send a test payload to a webhook URL. |

### `nvh workflow`

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `nvh workflow list` | List available workflows. |
| `nvh workflow run NAME` | Run a workflow pipeline. |
| `nvh workflow show NAME` | Show workflow steps and description. |
